items.name: Upland Lord's Glass Ring
items.lore: Won from Lightwarden Eochaid on the Glimmering Upland. It shines in the dark, and it shouldn't.

items.name: Inquisitor's Blue Torc
items.lore: The Azure Grand Inquisitor's torc, the crown crossed out. Ailill wouldn't touch it.

items.name: Valley Warlord's Bracer
items.lore: Won from the Warlord of the Valleys. Brighter than you. Always brighter.

items.name: King's Guard Belt
items.lore: The King's Champion's belt, won in the East Valley.

items.name: Prince's Crown of Light
items.lore: Maldahar's circlet, worn as a torc. It went out when he did - mostly.

items.name: Maldahar's Glass Cloak
items.lore: Woven glass, light as silk. It throws the sun back in your enemies' eyes.

items.name: Mantle of the Southern Muster
items.lore: Four halls' colours in one mantle, given to those who stood in the Prince's Hollow.

items.name: Lightbreaker's Torc
items.lore: Dark glass, bound in bronze. Whatever light it held, it holds no longer.

items.name: Hollow-Breaker's Belt
items.lore: Studded with dead glimmer-glass from the Prince's Hollow.

items.name: Ring of the Dark Lantern
items.lore: Keener Brid keened the valleys dark. This ring keeps a little of the dark.

items.name: Bracer of the East Valley
items.lore: The Muster's bracer, for the ones who broke the King's guard.

items.name: Unshining Jewel
items.lore: A glimmer-stone from the hills, found the morning the glow went out. It doesn't shine. That's the point.
